elaine.finance: Quick problem for month close: vendor CloudRack reversed a credit we applied in Feb (CR-2024-998) for $18,450. That credit lowered deferred revenue; the reversal hit AP/Cash this period. Need rev-rec treatment before lock.

raj.accounting: Paste the ERP lines and confirm whether any of that amount was recognized as revenue after the credit was posted.

elaine.finance: ERP extract: 2025-02-12 DR Cash 18,450 / CR Deferred Revenue 18,450 (credit memo applied). 2025-03-22 DR AP - CloudRack 18,450 / CR Cash 18,450 (reversal). No revenue recognized against this specific credit.

marta.revrec: If the original entry reduced the liability only, the reversal should reinstate deferred revenue. Proposed adjusting JE for 3/31: DR AP - CloudRack 18,450 / CR Deferred Revenue 18,450. Document as "restoration of prior-period liability due to vendor credit reversal."

kevin.cfo: Agree with reinstatement. Elaine, include vendor confirm email and screenshots in the close folder. If vendor later re-affirms it's final vs. tentative, we'll book any follow-ons then.

billing-bot: Reminder: month-end lock in 90 minutes. Post all adjustments to #finance-monthclose with attachments.

elaine.finance: Will upload backup now and wait for vendor reply before posting GL. Will flag if vendor says reversal was provisional. :thumbsup:
